collections.name: users
collections.access: Users can read their own profile. Users in the same org can read other user profiles (except maybe hiding sensitive info if needed, but standard profiles are readable). Owners/Admins can write.

collections.name: organizations
collections.access: Only owners and admins can read/write.

collections.name: projects

fields.name: assignedWorkers
fields.description: Array of user UIDs assigned to this project

collections.access: Owners and managers (admin, project_manager, supervisor) can read/write all fields. Workers can read ONLY if their UID is in assignedWorkers, and they CANNOT read the financialData field (or we put financial data in a subcollection so workers can't read it).

collections.name: project_financials
collections.description: Subcollection under projects, or separate collection, to hold financials, so workers can't access it.
collections.access: Only owners, admins, and project_managers can read/write.

collections.name: tasks
collections.access: Owners/managers can read/write all tasks in their org. Workers can read/write tasks assigned to them.

collections.name: updates

fields.name: workerId
fields.description: UID of the worker who submitted this

collections.access: Owners/managers can read/write. Workers can read/write only if workerId == their UID.
